title: ReportEmailRequest
description: Message published by user-service to the SQS queue user-service-report-emails (no SNS topic) after a scan is marked COMPLETADO. Consumed by user-service itself. Delivery is at-least-once: consumers dedupe through the Postgres report_email_status claim. See `docs/decisions.md` (D-19).

scan_id.description: Scan identifier, same free-form string as correlation_id in scan-outcome.

requested_at.description: RFC 3339 with offset. The pattern is there because format is only an annotation in draft 2020-12.
